notes.title: Try the demo for our next game, An English Haunting
notes.content:
Last July we announced [i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2474030/An_English_Haunting/]An English Haunting[/url][/b][/i], our next game. It's a story about ghosthunting, the search for a mysterious artefact, and the most haunted manor of 1907 England. Here's the teaser trailer:

[previewyoutube=cgwOTr1Hjjg;full][/previewyoutube]

Professor Patrick Moore will suddenly find himself in a race against the clock to prove the existence of the Great Beyond. He'll attend séances, befriend a fake medium named Beatrice Shaw, meet Arthur Conan Doyle and travel from the foggy streets of London to the steep shores of Scotland.

We're collaborating with enComplot, the makers of [i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1185380/The_Season_of_the_Warlock/]The Season of the Warlock[/url][/b][/i] (check it out too!) to bring this to you. Look at the chilling key art they've produced:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40689962/9c2971e6af4fcc11eda03294bb2b9840f1d2407f.png[/img]

Check the demo at the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2474030/An_English_Haunting/]Steam page[/url], and please wishlist!

Oh, and we've also discounted [b][i]Nightmare Frames[/i][/b] for this Halloween. Welcome to the spooky season!

notes.title: Nightmare Frames anniversary & awards celebration: 20 % off and trading cards!
notes.content:
[b][i]Nightmare Frames[/i][/b] will be one year old next Friday 16th, and we're celebrating with a 20 % discount and Steam trading cards.

When the game was released, we didn't expect such a big success. Our heartfelt thanks to all the people who played, reviewed, and talked about the game. It's been a great year, and we won't stop celebratring here, expect more news from us soon...

Another reason for us to be joyful -- [b][i]Nightmare Frames[/i][/b] is now the proud winner of six AGS awards! The AGS Awards 2022 ceremony was held on May 27th and the Adventure Game Studio community granted the game some coveted trophies: [b]Best Game of the Year[/b], [b]Best Gameplay[/b], [b]Best Writing[/b], [b]Best Character[/b], [b]Best Puzzles[/b], and [b]Best Music & Sound[/b].

Adventure Game Studio is an open source engine which has produced some of the most beloved point-and-click adventures of the last 20 years, such as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/336140/Unavowed/][i]Unavowed[/i][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/307580/Technobabylon/][i]Technobabylon[/i][/url] or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/631570/Whispers_of_a_Machine/][i]Whispers of a Machine[/i][/url].

The list of the Best AGS Game winners over the years is long and glorious, and it's increible to be in such company! We were fortunate to join the bunch back in 2020 with our own freeware [i]Urban Witch Story[/i]. That our first commercial foray is joining makes us proud.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1182310/The_Excavation_of_Hobs_Barrow/][i]The Excavation of Hob's Barrow[/i][/url] won Best Voicework and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1709730/Beyond_The_Edge_Of_Owlsgard/][i]Beyond the Edge of Owlsgard[/i][/url] Best Art, Best Animation, and Best Character Art. Celebrate them too!
